fine_lines.title: because vs so
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما أداة ربط تجمع جملتين. because تقدّم السبب وتجيب عن why? أما so فتقدّم النتيجة وتجيب عن What happened? لاحظ أن ترتيب الأفكار ينعكس: [نتيجة] because [سبب] / [سبب] so [نتيجة].
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both join two sentences. "Because" gives the reason and answers "Why?". "So" gives the result and answers "What happened?". The order flips: [result] because [reason] / [reason], so [result].

examples.sentence: I got wet because it was raining.
It was raining, so I got wet.

fine_lines.title: so vs very
fine_lines.explanation_ar: so كظرف تعني "جدًا" مثل very لكنها أقوى وتُستعمل كثيرًا في الكلام، وغالبًا يتبعها نتيجة: He talks so fast (that) I can't understand him.
fine_lines.explanation_en: As an adverb, "so" means "very" but is stronger and common in speech. It often has a result after it: He talks so fast (that) I can't understand him.

examples.sentence: He talks so fast I can't understand him.

expressions.meaning_en: I believed that was true, and I was right.

expressions.example: "I broke the cup." "So what happened?" "I had to pay for it."

expressions.meaning_en: It was the correct thing to do.
expressions.example: I helped him because it was the right thing.

grammar.title: because = reason (answers "Why?")
grammar.explanation_ar: because أداة ربط تجمع جملتين، والجملة التي بعدها هي السبب. تجيب عن سؤال why. ولا تستعمل because إلا كأداة ربط.
grammar.explanation_en: "Because" joins two sentences; the part after it is the reason. It answers "Why?". "Because" is only a conjunction.
examples: "Why are you late?" "Because the train was late."
I helped him because he was a nice man.

grammar.title: so = result (answers "What happened?")
grammar.explanation_ar: so أيضًا أداة ربط، لكن الجملة التي بعدها هي النتيجة. تجيب عن سؤال What happened? ونضع فاصلة قبلها عادة.
grammar.explanation_en: "So" is also a conjunction, but the part after it is the result. It answers "What happened?". We usually put a comma before it.
examples: It was hot, so I bought an ice cream.
I broke it, so I had to pay for it.

grammar.title: so as an adverb of extent
grammar.explanation_ar: so يمكن أن تكون ظرفًا بمعنى "جدًا" لتبين المدى أو الدرجة: so fast, so hot, so polite.
grammar.explanation_en: "So" can be an adverb meaning "very" to show extent or degree: so fast, so hot, so polite.

grammar.title: so for truth: I think so / I thought so
grammar.explanation_ar: نستعمل so بعد think للتعبير عن أن الشيء صحيح في رأينا: I think so = أظن أنه صحيح. I thought so = كنت أظن ذلك وكنت محقًّا.
grammar.explanation_en: Use "so" after "think" to say you believe something is true: "I think so" = I believe it's true. "I thought so" = I believed it, and I was right.
examples: "Is it going to rain?" "I think so."

questions.question: "I am late ___ the train was late."
questions.explanation_en: The second part is the reason: because.

questions.question: "It was raining hard, ___ I got wet."
questions.explanation_en: The second part is the result: so.

questions.question: "Because" answers the question ___.
questions.explanation_ar: because تقدّم السبب فتجيب عن why.
questions.explanation_en: "Because" gives the reason, so it answers "Why?".

questions.question: "Are you sick?" "Yes." "I thought ___."
questions.explanation_en: The correct expression is "I thought so".

questions.question: "Canadians are ___ polite." (= very)
questions.explanation_en: Here "so" is an adverb meaning very.

questions.question: Which sentence is logical?
choices: I broke it because I had to pay for it.
I helped him, so he is a nice man.
I broke it, so I had to pay for it.
It was hot because I bought an ice cream.
questions.explanation_ar: الكسر أولًا ثم النتيجة: الدفع. لذلك so.
questions.explanation_en: First I broke it, then the result: I paid. So "so" is right.

questions.question: "I helped him pay for it ___ he was a nice man."
questions.explanation_en: Him being nice is the reason: because.

questions.question: What is a conjunction?
choices: a word that joins two ideas
a word that describes a noun
questions.explanation_ar: أداة الربط تجمع فكرتين أو جملتين.
questions.explanation_en: A conjunction joins two ideas or sentences.

questions.question: "People weren't buying, so the shop ___ its prices."
questions.explanation_en: The result: the shop dropped (lowered) its prices.
